name: ai-commands
title: AI Commands
description: Translate and rewrite selected or copied text with Claude Code, Codex, Grok, OpenCode, or direct APIs. Preview the result and press Enter to replace the selection. Individual root-search entries require separate local setup.
author: vdmkotai

commands.name: ai-commands
commands.title: AI Commands
commands.description: Run and manage your saved AI commands.

commands.name: run-ai-command
commands.title: Run AI Command
commands.description: Run or edit a saved command from its main-search entry.

commands.name: ai-command-history
commands.title: AI Command History
commands.description: Browse and clear locally saved results.

commands.name: check-harnesses
commands.title: Check AI Harnesses
commands.description: Check CLI availability, API connections, and model discovery.

preferences.name: claudePath
preferences.title: Claude Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to the installed Claude Code CLI. Otherwise detected automatically.

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Codex Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to the installed Codex CLI.

preferences.name: grokPath
preferences.title: Grok Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to the installed Grok CLI.

preferences.name: opencodePath
preferences.title: OpenCode Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to OpenCode 1.18.29 or later. Uses its saved provider connections.

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Used only when a command selects OpenAI API. API usage is billed by the provider.

preferences.name: anthropicApiKey
preferences.title: Anthropic API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Used only when a command selects Anthropic API. API usage is billed by the provider.

preferences.name: xaiApiKey
preferences.title: xAI API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Used only when a command selects xAI API. API usage is billed by the provider.

preferences.name: saveHistory
preferences.title: History
preferences.label: Save input and results locally
preferences.description: Keep up to 100 completed runs. You can clear them in AI Command History.

scripts.format: prettier --write src test scripts package.json tsconfig.json '*.md'
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
